response.sql: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Employee AS e JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), rep_stats AS (SELECT City, customer_count, AVG(customer_count) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_average, SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS overall_customer_total FROM rep_counts) SELECT City, SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers, AVG(customer_count - city_average) AS average_above_city_average, AVG(1.0 * customer_count / overall_customer_total) AS average_share_of_overall_customers FROM rep_stats WHERE customer_count > city_average GROUP BY City;
